input_sentence: OpenAI rolled out GPT-5.5 Instant as the default model in ChatGPT in May 2026.
headline: GPT-5.5 Instant Is Now ChatGPT's Default Model for Everyone
dek: OpenAI swapped in GPT-5.5 Instant on May 5, 2026, promising 52.5% fewer hallucinations on high-stakes prompts and more concise replies for hundreds of millions of users.
summary: On May 5, 2026, OpenAI replaced GPT-5.3 Instant with GPT-5.5 Instant as the default model across all ChatGPT tiers — Free, Go, Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, and Edu — requiring no action from users. The model targets reliability over raw capability: OpenAI's internal benchmarks show a 52.5% drop in hallucinations on high-stakes medical, legal, and financial prompts, and a 37.3% reduction in inaccurate claims on conversations previously flagged by users. The rollout also introduced memory-source visibility and enhanced personalization from past chats, files, and Gmail. Community reaction has been mixed, with factual-task users praising the upgrade while creative writers report the new model feels more conservative and hedging.

key_facts.value: May 5, 2026 — GPT-5.5 Instant replaced GPT-5.3 Instant as ChatGPT's default for all user tiers.

key_facts.label: Hallucination reduction
key_facts.value: 52.5% fewer hallucinated claims than GPT-5.3 Instant on high-stakes prompts (medicine, law, finance) per OpenAI internal evaluation.

key_facts.value: AIME 2025 score rose from 65.4 (GPT-5.3 Instant) to 81.2 (GPT-5.5 Instant).

key_facts.label: Multimodal benchmark
key_facts.value: MMMU-Pro multimodal reasoning improved from 69.2 to 76.0.

key_facts.label: GPT-5.3 Instant retirement window
key_facts.value: GPT-5.3 Instant remains available to paid users for three months via model settings before retirement.

key_facts.label: Personalization expansion
key_facts.value: As of June 9, 2026, personalization improvements began rolling out to ChatGPT Go and Free tiers; Free-tier responses draw from a reduced set of past chats.

why_it_matters: GPT-5.5 Instant is the model that hundreds of millions of everyday ChatGPT users encounter without ever choosing a model — making it the de facto face of consumer AI for most people. Cutting hallucinations on medical, legal, and financial queries by more than half is a meaningful trust signal as AI moves from novelty to daily production tool in workplaces. The simultaneous introduction of memory-source controls also sets a new baseline for transparency in AI personalization, directly addressing privacy concerns that surfaced with earlier memory features.

extras.rollout_status: Live as ChatGPT default for all tiers (Free, Go, Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, Edu) since May 5, 2026. Available in the API as 'chat-latest'. Enhanced personalization (past chats, files, Gmail) live for Plus/Pro on web; rolling out to Go and Free as of June 9, 2026. GPT-5.3 Instant remains available to paid users for three months before retirement.

benchmarks_or_specs.value: 30.2% fewer words and 29.2% fewer lines on equivalent prompts vs. GPT-5.3 Instant

benchmarks_or_specs.value: 1,000,000 tokens (API); effective limit in Codex is 400,000 tokens

reactions.take: Frames the launch as a product-behavior change, not just a benchmark update — users will feel the shift through changed response tone, memory use, and retrieval choices rather than leaderboard numbers.

Community reaction is polarized: factual-task users praise faster, more direct replies, but creative and copywriting users report the model 'feels bland, refuses more, and hedges more,' comparing it to someone who just finished corporate compliance training.
GPT-5.5 and Claude Mythos Preview are close on advanced cyber tasks — GPT-5.5 scored 71.4% on expert tasks vs. 68.6% for Claude Mythos Preview, providing an independent outside benchmark near launch.
Highlighted that unlike Claude Opus 4.7 and GPT-5.5 standard, GPT-5.5 Instant is available to all users at no cost, positioning it as a meaningful upgrade to the baseline free experience.

whats_next: Full rollout of enhanced personalization (past chats, files, Gmail) to Free, Go, Business, and Enterprise users — underway as of June 9, 2026 for Go and Free.
Mobile rollout of memory-source controls and personalization features, which were initially web-only.
GPT-5.3 Instant retirement: paid users have a three-month window from May 5, 2026, before the older model is sunset.
Watch for independent long-form factuality benchmarks — OpenAI's gains are largely tied to tool grounding; standalone factuality against rivals like Claude remains a key comparison point.
Monitor whether GPT-5.6, briefly referenced in Codex logs mid-May 2026, moves from backend canary testing to a formal launch.
